name: Differential scanning calorimetry of SBR rubber
description: Calorimetric material characterization with paired pans,not a generic magnetic-coil cryostat.

sources.citation: NETZSCH DSC214Polyma primary SBR rubber application

requirements.rationale: The experiment needs differential heat-flow sensing against a reference.
Replicate the reported -100 to220 C heating window.
Dynamic nitrogen atmosphere is part of the reported measurement; do not assume it is installed on every calorimeter.

missing_information: The paper reports NETZSCHDSC214Polyma; LinkamDSC600 is a different real candidate,not falsely labeled as the reported instrument.
An installed dynamic nitrogen purge is not established for the Linkam configuration and stays UNKNOWN.
Animations never display fabricated thermograms or transition temperatures.
confirmation_note: Source-specific requirements reviewed by the catalog author on 2026-10-31. They describe the selected procedure, not a universal limit. Users must confirm them before a run; edits require confirmation again.
